senses.gloss:
हुंकार हुंकार, i. e. हुम् (an imitative sound), -कार, m.
 1. Uttering a menacing sound, Rājat. 5, 345.
 2. Roaring, bellowing, Pañc. 162, 25 (of an elephant).
 3. Twang (of a bow), Śāk. d. 52.

हूंकार हूंकार, i. e. हूम्-कार,
 1. Uttering the sound हूम्, Dev. 6, 9; as injury, Man. 11, 204.
 2. Roaring, Kathās. 4, 24.

हूंकृति हूंकृति, i. e. हूम्-कृति (cf. the last), f.
 1. Making हूम्, sound of a sleeping person, Kathās. 3, 64, at the end of a comp. adj.
 2. Injury, Nalod. 2, 5.
